subject: Usage threshold hit — 20m runbook offer (Brightloom)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah@brightloom.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-05-14T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Usage threshold hit — quick 20m runbook offer

Hi Sarah —

Congrats on the early ramp — I flagged Brightloom’s project after our system hit your trial threshold this morning. If it helps, we can do a short 20-minute runbook to walk through the latency/cost knobs we typically tune for ingestion-heavy pipelines. Typical agenda:
- Quick signal review (what the threshold looked like)
- Recommended batching/cache settings for your workload
- One or two quick config changes you can test live

I can join a short call today or tomorrow. Quick options: 11:00am or 3:00pm PT today, or 10:00am / 2:30pm PT tomorrow — or you can pick a slot here: https://cal.redwood.com/ben/20m

I attached a two-page agenda. Grace (copied) will own the handoff if you want follow-up runbooks and a short post-call summary.

Cheers,
Ben
Ben Carter
SDR, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF)]

Hi Ben —

Thanks — appreciate the quick ping. We did see the burst this morning; our ops lead (ops@brightloom.ai) will want to join. Today is tight for us, but 2:30pm PT works if that's still open. If not, tomorrow morning is safest (10am PT).

Also: our runbook tends to focus on streaming ingestion patterns (variable seq lengths). If you can include one example of recommended batch size + kv-cache settings, that'd be ideal.

—Sarah
